1: // Canvas Avoider game with enhanced graphics
2: (() => {
3:   // Audio setup
4:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
5:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
6:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
7:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
8:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
9:     osc.type = 'sine';
10:     osc.connect(gain);
11:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
12:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
13:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
14:     osc.start();
15:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration / 1000);
16:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration / 1000);
17:   }
18:   function playCollision() { playTone(120, 200); }
19:   function playSpawn() { playTone(440, 80); }
20: 
21:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
22:   if (!canvas) return;
23:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
24:   const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
25:   const w = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth * dpr;
26:   const h = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight * dpr;
27:   ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);
28: 
29:   // player
30:   const player = {x: w/2, y: h/2, r: 10, speed: 200}; // px/s
31:   const keys = {};
32:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
33:     keys[e.key] = true;
34:     if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
35:   });
36:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => keys[e.key] = false);
37: 
38:   // obstacles
39:   const obstacles = [];
40:   const spawnInterval = 800; // ms
41:   let lastSpawn = 0;
42: 
43:   // timing
44:   let startTime = null;
45:   let gameOver = false;
46: 
47: function update(dt) {
48:     // move player
49:     if (keys.ArrowUp) player.y -= player.speed * dt;
50:     if (keys.ArrowDown) player.y += player.speed * dt;
51:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) player.x -= player.speed * dt;
52:     if (keys.ArrowRight) player.x += player.speed * dt;
53:     // keep inside canvas
54:     player.x = Math.max(player.r, Math.min(w - player.r, player.x));
55:     player.y = Math.max(player.r, Math.min(h - player.r, player.y));
56: 
57:     // spawn obstacles
58:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > spawnInterval) {
59:       const size = 20 + Math.random()*30;
60:       const x = Math.random()*w;
61:       const y = Math.random()*h;
62:       const angle = Math.random()*2*Math.PI;
63:       const speed = 50 + Math.random()*100;
64:       obstacles.push({
65:         x,
66:         y,
67:         w: size,
68:         h: size,
69:         vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
70:         vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed,
71:         angle: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
72:         angularVelocity: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2,
73:         color: `hsl(${Math.random() * 360},70%,50%)`
74:       });
75:       playSpawn();
76:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
77:     }
78: 
79:     // move obstacles and rotate
80:     for (let i=obstacles.length-1;i>=0;i--) {
81:       const o = obstacles[i];
82:       o.x += o.vx*dt;
83:       o.y += o.vy*dt;
84:       o.angle += (o.angularVelocity || 0) * dt;
85:       // remove if out of bounds
86:       if (o.x < -o.w || o.x > w || o.y < -o.h || o.y > h) obstacles.splice(i,1);
87:     }
88: 
89:     // collision detection
90:     for (const o of obstacles) {
91:       const closestX = Math.max(o.x, Math.min(player.x, o.x+o.w));
92:       const closestY = Math.max(o.y, Math.min(player.y, o.y+o.h));
93:       const dx = player.x - closestX;
94:       const dy = player.y - closestY;
95:       if (dx*dx + dy*dy < player.r*player.r) {
96:         playCollision();
97:         gameOver = true;
98:         break;
99:       }
100:     }
101:   }
102: 
103: 
104:   }
105: 
106:   function draw() {
107:     // background gradient
108:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, w, h);
109:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001028');
110:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000814');
111:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
112:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
113: 
114:     // player with radial gradient and glow
115:     const playerGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
116:       player.x, player.y, player.r * 0.2,
117:       player.x, player.y, player.r
118:     );
119:     playerGrad.addColorStop(0, '#00aaff');
120:     playerGrad.addColorStop(1, '#0066ff');
121:     ctx.save();
122:     ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,102,255,0.6)';
123:     ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
124:     ctx.fillStyle = playerGrad;
125:     ctx.beginPath();
126:     ctx.arc(player.x, player.y, player.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
127:     ctx.fill();
128:     ctx.restore();
129: 
130:     // obstacles with individual colors and rotation
131:     for (const o of obstacles) {
132:       ctx.save();
133:       ctx.translate(o.x + o.w / 2, o.y + o.h / 2);
134:       ctx.rotate(o.angle || 0);
135:       ctx.fillStyle = o.color || 'red';
136:       ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
137:       ctx.shadowBlur = 4;
138:       ctx.fillRect(-o.w / 2, -o.h / 2, o.w, o.h);
139:       ctx.restore();
140:     }
141: 
142:     // score overlay
143:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
144:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
145:     ctx.textAlign = 'left';
146:     const elapsed = ((performance.now() - startTime) / 1000).toFixed(2);
147:     ctx.fillText(`Time: ${elapsed}s`, 10, 20);
148:     if (gameOver) {
149:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
150:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
151:       ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
152:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
153:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
154:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', w / 2, h / 2);
155:     }
156:   }
157: 
158:   function loop(ts) {
159:     if (!startTime) startTime = ts;
160:     const dt = (ts - (lastTime||ts))/1000;
161:     lastTime = ts;
162:     if (!gameOver) update(dt);
163:     draw();
164:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
165:   }
166:   let lastTime;
167:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
168: })();
